title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
description: Find coordinates of cells from which water can flow to both Pacific and Atlantic oceans.
pseudocode:
1. dfs(r, c, visited, prevHeight)
2. if out of bounds or height < prevHeight or visited, return
3. visited.add(r, c)
4. for each neighbor (nr, nc):
5.   dfs(nr, nc, visited, matrix[r][c])
6. run dfs from all boundary cells for Pacific and Atlantic
7. find intersection of visited sets

steps.note: Initialize Pacific visited set at the top row (0,0)
Initialize Atlantic visited set at the bottom row (1,1)
Intersection of Pacific and Atlantic sets for matrix [[1,2],[3,4]]
